field.name: body_html
field.t: Congratulations on your new home! We are sending you this e-mail to confirm that we have received payment for your home warranty. As we know moving is a hectic time and sometimes our paperwork gets lost in the closing documents, we are sending you a few items.
We are sending you this e-mail to confirm that we have received payment for your home warranty. Further, we are sending you a few items for your information.
field.p: First, we have included an invoice that shows your home warranty has been paid. Second, we have included a document that explains our service process. Finally, we have included the terms & conditions for your home warranty.
If you have any questions, you can reach us at (888) 509-2916 or at info@achosahw.com. Thank you and have a wonderful day!
